description: Online news plus a readiness checklist. News must cite a source. Do not speculate about a mode that has not been announced. Checklist rows are generic preparation, not GTA VI online facts.

news.title: No online mode announced
news.source: Project brief for this tracker, recorded 20 November 2026. Not a publisher statement copied from the web.
news.detail: As of 20 November 2026 this tracker has no verified announcement of a GTA VI online mode. Launch is recorded as single-player on 19 November 2026. Replace this note when a primary source says otherwise.

news.title: PLACEHOLDER: Online news item - to be filled from a verified source
news.detail: PLACEHOLDER: Dated announcement to be filled from a verified source. Do not speculate.

checklist.title: Settle the aim setup you will actually keep
checklist.source: Generic readiness idea for a future competitive mode. Not a GTA VI online fact.
checklist.detail: Pick one sensitivity and one aim-assist category and leave them alone while you play the story. Muscle memory is the point. This does not describe an announced online mode.

checklist.title: Practise calm recoveries in a car
checklist.source: Generic readiness idea for a future competitive mode. Not a GTA VI online fact.
checklist.detail: Use the driving drills until a slide is something you steer out of, rather than something you panic through. There is no verified online handling model to copy.

checklist.title: Learn the controls in the story first
checklist.source: Generic readiness idea for a future competitive mode. Not a GTA VI online fact.
checklist.detail: Finish the story missions you care about before any future online mode, so you are not learning the pad under pressure. This is preparation only.

checklist.title: Note what you like once the lists are verified
checklist.source: Generic readiness idea for a future competitive mode. Not a GTA VI online fact.
checklist.detail: When the vehicle and weapon entries stop being placeholders, tick the ones you actually enjoy. Do not plan a loadout from unverified rows.

checklist.title: Agree house rules with your friend
checklist.source: Generic readiness idea for a future competitive mode. Not a GTA VI online fact.
checklist.detail: Before a competitive mode exists, agree how you will play: no story spoilers, and whether you are there to win or to mess about. The tracker cannot settle that for you.
